title: 马克斯AI抢工作：会替人交税吗，政府收入怎么办
speaker: Howard Marks

segments.en: Well, I think that the sentient human being has to think about these things, has to acknowledge there's nothing we can do about it.
segments.zh: 我认为有感知力的人必须思考这些事情，必须承认我们对此无能为力。

segments.en: And when I reach that point in my own process, I kind of let it go, because my wife defines worrying as bleeding before you're shot.
segments.zh: 当我在自己的思考过程中走到这一步，我就放下了，因为我妻子把担忧定义为中枪之前先流血。

segments.en: And in this case, there's nothing we can do about it. Nothing's certainly nothing I can do about it personally. So you roll with it.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，我们无能为力。就我个人而言，肯定什么都做不了。所以只能顺势而为。

segments.en: That's all. You acknowledge it. You let people think about it. But it should not be a preoccupation, am I?
segments.zh: 就这样。你承认它，让人们去思考它。但它不应该成为执念，对吧？

segments.en: Are you satisfied people are thinking about it enough or in the right way? Well, people are. On the other hand, I don't see anything out of government.
segments.zh: 你满意人们思考得足够多或方式正确吗？人们在思考。但另一方面，我没看到政府有什么动作。

segments.en: You know, I think there should be a task force on the effect of the coming effect of AI. And there isn't.
segments.zh: 我认为应该有一个关于AI即将带来的影响的工作组。但现在没有。

segments.en: Now, when they form the task force, I don't know what they can do about it. But it might be nice to think about it.
segments.zh: 等他们成立工作组时，我不知道他们能做什么。但思考一下总是好的。

segments.en: And if you want one little task to work on, how about this? If people are put out of work, they won't pay taxes. If AI takes their place as workers, will it take their place as taxpayers and how?
segments.zh: 如果你想找一个小的任务来研究，这个怎么样？如果人们失业，他们就不会交税。如果AI取代他们成为劳动者，它会取代他们成为纳税人吗？怎么取代？

segments.en: So what will happen to government revenues when and if people lose their jobs?
segments.zh: 那么，当人们失去工作时，政府收入会发生什么变化？
